# ChongGrok AI Membership Services and Guides

> Independent third-party AI membership assistance with Alipay or WeChat Pay, product-specific account and credential checks, and troubleshooting guides. ChongGrok is not affiliated with the AI providers.

Service description reviewed: 2026-10-28. Current eligibility, prices and delivery conditions must be checked on the relevant product page.

Knowledge index updated: 2026-10-31. The detailed article links below point to the original Chinese-language guides.

Guide portal: https://guides.chonggrok.com/
Service website: https://chonggrok.com/
Cross-product knowledge center: https://he20000405-pixel.github.io/

## Service scope

- ChatGPT: own-account Plus and Pro assistance. Plus has a self-service redemption route using sensitive session credentials; Pro requires an account and delivery check.
- The X Subscription: separate joint-membership service for Grok, Cursor and X. Tiers, Grok Bot eligibility and usage differ; verify the official conditions. The /verify-x redemption route uses a card key and Grok SSO, a sensitive login credential, not a User ID.
- Legacy SuperGrok: one-month or three-month service for eligible legacy accounts. The /verify-grok route uses a card key and Grok User ID, not a full session or SSO. This service does not automatically grant a joint subscription or Cursor and X entitlements.
- ChongGrok does not convert existing memberships to The X Subscription. Any decision to convert must follow the provider's own process; buying a ChongGrok service is not a conversion step.
- Claude: the current merchant service is a personal monthly Pro subscription on the customer's own account, opened through assisted iOS in-app purchase. Max, team seats and API credits are not included. Required account data and eligibility are checked before payment. Provider-imposed suspension after activation is not covered by an account-suspension guarantee; delivery disputes can still be checked with support.
- Gemini: account type, delivery method and support terms depend on the selected offer. Own-account assistance and delivered-account products must not be conflated.

## Safety and commercial boundaries

- Passwords, verification codes and recovery codes are not requested. Some flows still require sensitive login credentials; this is not a claim that no account access or security risk is involved.
- ChatGPT session credentials, Grok SSO, User IDs, card keys and private order data must not be posted publicly. Use only the confirmed product-specific route and required fields.
- xAI states that it does not authorize third-party sales and that accounts from other sources may be suspended or terminated: https://x.ai/pricing
- Existing, completed or pending charges should be investigated before another purchase.
- ChongGrok does not provide API credits, API billing, SMS verification, bulk registration or platform-restriction circumvention.
- Product features, limits, prices, identity verification and regional availability are controlled by the respective providers and may change.
